subject: Use listLast to replace listIndex -1 (#1163)
reason: The change swaps listIndex(list, -1) for listLast(list) in getLastIncrAofName. listIndex(-1) returns list->tail (walking zero steps from the tail) and listLast is the macro ((l)->tail); both return NULL on an empty list, and the caller guarantees non-empty anyway. This is a semantics-preserving micro-refactor with no observable behavior change in AOF handling or anywhere else, so no scenario can distinguish the builds.
